pdf_sem_manifesto: Acquisition WITHOUT integrity manifest — nothing is asserted about preservation.
gc_titulo_janela: Case and Chain of Custody Manager
gc_tt_excluir_caso: Sends the whole case to the Windows Recycle Bin (restorable), after you confirm by typing its name. The deletion is kept in the access log.
gc_dispositivos_do_caso: Devices in the case — the document buttons below apply to the device selected in this list:
gc_tt_exportar: Copies the selected documents (Ctrl/Shift for several) to a USB drive or folder, verifies each copy by its hash, issues a receipt and records it in the case.
gc_tt_autorizacao: Attaches the court order, consent form or request to the case — including when the document was only scanned after the collection.
gc_tt_relatorio: Converts SMS, calls and contacts into one CSV per artifact (opens in Excel) and a consolidated PDF, outside the sealed acquisition.
gc_tt_relatorio_extracao: Issues the acquisition's technical report: environment, method, outcome per module, files by category, inventory and seal.
gc_tt_ficha: Quick-read cover: opens with what the collection obtained — lock state when received, device and line identification, security and outcome. Each field cites its sealed source; what did not come through is marked NOT DETERMINED.
gc_tt_laudo: Issues the device's forensic examination report: material examined, methodology, limitations, results, integrity and conclusion, with the examiner's statements.
gc_tt_conversas: Pick the relevant conversations (WhatsApp, SMS, MMS) and generate their PDF, in full. The complete set of all of them stays in the spreadsheet and the HTML notebook.
gc_tt_decifrar: Android: decrypts the WhatsApp backup (.crypt15) with the 64-digit key. iPhone: decrypts the encrypted backup with the backup password. The cleartext material stays outside the sealed acquisition.
gc_nenhum_caso: No case found in the extractions folder.
gc_sem_aquisicao: This case has no acquisition recorded yet.
gc_ficha_divergentes:
⚠ Case data divergent across acquisitions: {campos}.
The record shows the version from the most recent acquisition. Use 'Amend Case Data' to create the case's single record.
gc_ficha_caso_anterior: Case predating the single record: the data below was read from within the acquisitions.
gc_excluir_corpo:
The whole case {nome} — acquisitions, documents, reports and addenda — will be sent to the Windows Recycle Bin. You can restore it from there; deleting it for good means emptying the Recycle Bin.

To confirm, type the case name ({nome}):
gc_caso_excluido_corpo: Case {nome} was sent to the Windows Recycle Bin and the deletion was recorded.
gc_doc_nao_gerado_corpo:
The document could not be generated:
{erro}
gc_selecione_aquisicao: Select an acquisition in the list.
gc_senha_iphone_gerada: Temporary password generated by the suite in this acquisition (stored in backup_ios_cifrado/senha_do_backup.txt and checked against the seal). Confirm to decrypt:
gc_senha_iphone_definida: Backup password set on the iPhone (not the unlock passcode). It will appear in the decryption record so it can be repeated:
gc_examinador_subscreve_corpo:
This report will be signed by {nome}.

If that is not you, close this window and use 'Switch examiner', at the bottom of the sidebar.
gc_laudo_protocolos_falha: The report was generated, but the responses to the questions submitted could NOT be filed with the case ({erro}). They exist only inside the report.
gc_docs_contagem: {n} document(s) for this acquisition — double-click to open.
gc_docs_nenhum: No document generated yet for this acquisition. Use the buttons below.
gc_escolha_documento: Choose a document in the list.
gc_selecione_documentos: Select one or more documents in the list.
gc_salvar_copia_titulo: Save a copy of the document
gc_selecione_caso: Select a case in the list.
gc_caso_retificado_corpo:
The case record was updated and the change was recorded as an addendum, with the previous values.

The already-sealed acquisitions were not touched.
gc_selecione_dispositivo_retificar: Select a device in the list to amend.
gc_selada_corpo:
This collection already has an integrity manifest.

Rewriting it would make the case diverge from its own seal and would erase the record of what existed at the time of examination.

The change can be filed as an ADDENDUM to the case: the collected material stays untouched, and the amendment is recorded with its own date.

File it as an addendum?
gc_autorizacao_anexada_corpo:
Attached to the case:
  {lista}

The case was re-sealed and the filing was recorded as an addendum, with each document's hash.

The earlier acquisitions were NOT altered and do not come to include this document: each one records what was visible at the time it was made.
gc_selecione_dispositivo: Select a device in the list.
gc_selecione_aquisicao_especifica: Select a specific acquisition to generate the report.
gc_fuso_corpo:
The device's dates are in numeric form and need to be converted. The chosen time zone will be stated in the report.

The device's own clock, measured at collection, is in the acquisition's registro_procedimento.txt — check it if in doubt.
gc_sem_planilha: NO CSV SPREADSHEET WAS GENERATED, because there was no record to present. The reasons are above and in PROCEDENCIA.txt.
gc_descartes: ATTENTION: {n} fragment(s) of the raw material could NOT be interpreted and are not in the report. It is incomplete relative to the evidence — see NAO_INTERPRETADO.txt.
gc_origens_divergentes: ATTENTION: the source material no longer matches the collection seal: {origens}
gc_relatorio_nao_altera: The acquisition was not altered: the report is a derived document and stays outside what was sealed.

te_sub_entrar: Choose your name and enter your password.

te_admin_aviso: Test account for those who develop the suite. It exists only in the development build. Everything it produces comes marked as TEST — NO FORENSIC VALUE, inside the acquisition seal and on every page of the documents.
te_admin_sub_criar: First use on this machine: set the password (minimum {min} characters).
te_novo_sub: Fill in as it should appear in the documents.

te_primeiro_acesso_de: First sign-in for {nome}: set your password (minimum {min} characters)

mw_log_erro_cadeia: [!] Error saving the chain of custody: {erro}

mw_sem_extracao_so_celular: Examination without extraction is for a mobile phone (Android or iPhone).
mw_selecione_tipo: Select at least one extraction type.
mw_selecione_unidade: Select a disk drive before starting.
mw_confirmar_extracao:
This extraction will be recorded as performed by {nome}.
If that is not you, switch examiner first.
mw_confirmar_sem_extracao:
This examination without extraction will be recorded as performed by {nome}.
If that is not you, switch examiner first.
mw_confirmar_teste: TEST MODE: the acquisition and all its documents will be marked as TEST, with no forensic value.
mw_iphone_nao_autorizado_corpo: No iPhone connected that trusts this station. Connect the cable, unlock the screen, tap 'Trust' and click 'Check'.
mw_trocar_bloqueado: Wait for the extraction to finish before switching examiner: it is recorded in the name of {nome}.
mw_bloqueio_extracao: There is an extraction in progress: the suite cannot be closed now. Enter your password to return.
mw_fechar_extracao:
There is an extraction in progress. Exiting now would leave the acquisition without its seal (manifest) and without the closing record.

Click 'Cancel', wait for the extraction-finished message, and then exit.
mw_sobre_corpo:
{ferramenta}

Suite for acquisition and preservation of digital evidence from Android, iPhone and storage media, guided by ISO/IEC 27037.

The tool never asserts what it has not verified: absence of data in the acquired material does not permit concluding the data is absent from the device.

di_ph_estado: e.g. Powered on, cracked screen, powered off
di_rotulo_fotos: Photographs of the item ({min} required, for example front and back; up to {max}):
di_selecione_foto: Select in the list above the photo you want to remove.
di_lacre_obrigatorio: The device's seal number is required.
di_fotos_obrigatorias: Attach {min} photographs of the item (for example, front and back): they document the condition in which the device was received. {n} attached.
cd_ex_referencia: e.g. case, contract or request number
cd_ex_descricao: e.g. examination of two phones and an external disk
cd_aviso_edicao: The change applies to the case and is recorded as an addendum, with the previous value. The already-sealed acquisitions are not touched.
cd_caso_anterior: This case predates the single case record and has no data of its own. The acquisition will be linked to it, with the case data blank; it can be filled in later, in the Case Manager.
cd_preview_existente: The new device is added as one more acquisition of the chosen case.
cd_selecione_dispositivo: Select a device in the list.
cd_caso_existe_corpo: A case '{valor}' already exists. To add a device to it, use the 'Existing Case' tab.
fd_ja_anexado_titulo: Already attached to this case — also applies to this device
fd_tipo_termo_de_declaracoes: Consent form from the data subject
fd_nota_multiplos: More than one document can be attached — the authorization and an addendum, for example. Each one gets its own SHA-256.
fd_alcance:
What this attachment records: that the file, with the hash computed here, was attached to the case at the time of this acquisition.
What it does not record: authenticity, signature, competence or the dates stated in the document — that is established at the document's source, where the original is processed.
fd_ja_na_lista_corpo: This file has already been chosen to attach.
fd_sem_doc_corpo:
No authorization document was attached to this case.

The extraction can continue — the authorization exists regardless of whether the document is here —, but the case will record in full that nothing was attached, and the document can be filed later via the case manager.

Continue anyway?
md_sem_limitacoes: None of the selected modules declared limitations.
md_nota_limitacoes: These are limits of the method, not of this device. They ensure that the absence of a datum in the collected material is not read as the absence of the datum from the device.
md_titulo_alteracoes: What may be changed on the device
md_nota_alteracoes: This is what the run may cause. The change that actually occurs is recorded in the procedure record, at the moment it occurs.
es_explicacao: Record the device's condition and what was attempted. If the device powers on, the tool then attempts the connection, without altering it, and keeps its response as proof of the attempt. The report will say that extraction was not possible — not that the device has no data.
es_label_estado: Condition in which it was received
es_label_isolamento:
Isolated from the network (airplane mode or
Faraday bag)?
es_ph_tentativas: What the examiner did or attempted. E.g.: device powered on in the examiner's presence; PIN lock screen shown; credential not provided; no unlock attempt, to avoid triggering wipe-on-attempts.
es_campo_obrigatorio_corpo: Describe what was done or attempted. It is what supports the negative report.
hd_titulo: Chain of Custody — Check and Generate Manifests
hd_intro:
Check verifies that the material is still identical to the manifest. Generate seals a folder that has no manifest yet.
Each case can contain several acquisitions: sealing the acquisition covers that collection; sealing the case covers the whole project.
hd_ph_resultado: The result of the operation appears here.
hd_selecione: Select a case or an acquisition in the list.
hd_integro_corpo:
{resumo}

The verification report was saved in the folder.
hd_divergencia_corpo:
{resumo}

The material is NOT identical to the manifest. See the verification report saved in the folder to find exactly which files diverge.
hd_selada_corpo:
A manifest already exists in this folder.

To find out whether the material is still intact, use CHECK — generating again verifies nothing.

If you continue, the original manifest will be PRESERVED and a new one will be saved alongside it, with date and time in the name.

Generate anyway?

ex_ex_unidade: e.g. name of the laboratory or company

ex_excluir_proprio: Delete YOUR profile from this station? You will be signed out and will not be able to sign in with it again.

ex_confirmar_senha_corpo: Enter your password to delete the profile:
ex_perfil_excluido_corpo: Your profile has been deleted. The session was ended.
ex_novo_codigo_corpo: Generate a new code? The current code stops working.
ck_instrucao:
Enter the 64-digit key shown by WhatsApp when the end-to-end encrypted backup is enabled: 16 groups of 4 characters, in the same order as on the device screen (left to right, top to bottom).
You can also paste the whole key into any field.
ck_aviso: The key will be recorded in the case, as an addendum: it is what lets another examiner repeat the decryption. If one digit is wrong, nothing is decrypted.
dp_detalhe_inicial: Click 'Check Connection' to check the device.
dk_titulo_padrao: Disk Drive (computer, external HDD or USB drive)
dk_nenhuma: ✖ No drive detected. Connect the disk of the examined computer (via dock/adapter), an external HDD or a USB drive, and click 'Refresh Drives'.
dk_aviso_estacao: ⚠ This is the examiner station — the drive where HexisForensics is installed. It is not an object of examination, and examining it makes the collection read the disk on which its own output is being written.
